reuse.why: Calls the existing shared getScheduledAmount helper, which already handles missing, numeric and ranged amounts, instead of writing new range logic.

duplication.why: One added line in the model mapping; no logic is duplicated.

placement.why: The field is derived in scheduleModel.toExternal in api-models.ts, the layer that shapes schedules for the API.

scope.why: Type field, one mapping line, a unit test and a release note.

maintainability.why: Any future change to how an expected amount is computed flows through the single shared helper.
